input.summary: The original author data are unavailable, so reanalysis is not possible. The packet fields are mostly empty and several required decisions remain unresolved before a prospective emulated pilot can be proposed: delay placement, transfer size/workload, bottleneck configuration, and resource constraints.
clarification_questions: What is the delay placement for the 20 ms value — is it applied one-way (sender→receiver or receiver→sender) or round-trip (both directions), and which netem script/topology will be used (e.g., netem_cubic_benchmark_nines.py or netem_cubic_benchmark_hotnets.py)?
What TCP workload should be emulated — specifically, what file/transfer size(s) or flow duration(s), and what bottleneck bandwidth and queue parameters should be held fixed across conditions?
What resource constraints apply to this pilot — specifically, how many replications per configuration are needed, and is there a wall-time or cost ceiling the owner wants to enforce?
